I really hate today and April 3rd. Today would have been my grandpa’s 91st birthday. April 3rd 2006 was when he died. My grandpa was like my second dad. He was my best friend. I miss him so much. After he died I was diagnosed with depression, and I’m still grieving to this day.

I’m not ready for tomorrow. It’s been 12 years since my grandpa died and I’m still grieving. He was my best friend and the reason why I’m so heavily into wrestling. I’m gonna wear my Unleash Your Warrior shirt tomorrow to honor him, because Warrior was his favorite.

Depression sucks. April is kind of a horrible month for me. April 23rd, 2001 my grandpa(moms dad) died. April 3rd, 2006 my grandpa(dads dad) died. April 7th, 2013 my uncle died. Mania week and the few days after are my only happiness this April.
He got me hooked when I was 4, I’m 27 now. He died the night after Mania 22, he was so happy when he heard that Rey had won the world title. That was the last thing we talked about.

Wish I could have bought #ALLIN tickets but I can’t afford to go. Had to have brain surgery to relieve my massive headaches in January, so haven’t been able to go to work since then. This is not a pity tweet, just stating facts. Hope everyone one who got tickets has fun.
